status: Analytic reference for the generated-load interaction fixtures.
representation: The mechanics rows give analytic values. The outcome fields give the support states, gates and refusals expected for the fixtures. Source labels and row IDs are local to this reference.
binding: the product documents that bind this package author euler_bernoulli explicitly for every member of all three models; a Timoshenko selection changes rows (see the README). Compare these analytic mechanics rows after mapping quantity, entity, component and SI units. For combinations, apply DEL-05-02 REQ-016 to determine which row kinds the result publishes. Check published combination arithmetic bit for bit from the actual published operands. In each solved case, check that every expected generated source is recorded exactly once with its bound identity and factor 1. Compare the specified support states, gate decisions, refusal outcomes and row presence exactly. Compare a diagnostic code when the reference specifies one
theory: small-displacement linear-elastic 3D frame, Euler-Bernoulli, axial and torsional deformation included; supports rigid; a constant-effort support is a constant nodal force with no stiffness; a lift-off support is a rigid restraint on its degree of freedom while in contact and free while lifted

conventions.motion: global translation and right-handed rotation of the node
conventions.reaction: global force of the anchor on the structure at its node, moment about that node
conventions.member_end: global force and moment exerted on the member by its end node, moment about that end node (end i at the member's first node)
conventions.constant_effort: the force the support applies on the pipe, along +axis of its degree of freedom
conventions.nonlinear_support: reaction_Fz: the lift-off support's force on the pipe (0 when lifted); relative_uz: the node's uz less its ground's (the ground does not move here)
conventions.exact: sum of rational multiples of pi**k; an SRSS value is sqrt of such a sum
conventions.binary64_from_rounded_operands: on a combination row: RN(sqrt(sum z_i^2)) or RN(sum |z_i|) computed on the ideal rounded analytic operands z_i (the nearest binary64 of each exact operand row), each formed exactly and rounded once; not on operands a product published, which the binding uses instead
conventions.axial: a member-end force row along its member's own axis is the global component of the node-on-member end action associated with the elastic (effective) axial force N_el; with no pressure it equals the pipe-wall force. On CEF-EQ-SRSS and CEF-EQ-ABS such a row is a magnitude aggregated from those elastic axial components
conventions.comparison: the rule w16_exact_equivalent_static and w16_timoshenko_partial_wind state (DEC-024/DEC-026), with the scale taken per case, term or combination, in SI, expected being the exact value (its binary64 suffices). A row whose expected value is nonzero passes when abs(observed - expected) <= 1e-9 * abs(expected), the relative tolerance alone, with no floor. A row whose expected value is exactly zero passes when abs(observed) <= floor, the floor being 1e-9 times the largest magnitude of that row's family (force, moment, translation, rotation) in the same case, term or combination; where the whole family is zero there, floor = 1e-9 N or N*m, 1e-12 m or rad. Each of the 18 cases, terms and combinations with its own compared rows has a nonzero magnitude in all four compared families; JR-EQ-UNLISTED-PRIMITIVE uses JR-EQ's rows and floors. Each item's comparison_floor gives the floors for its exact-zero rows. The threshold g-factor, which is nonzero, is compared at 1e-9 relative; its floor 1e-12 would apply only to an exact-zero value. Discrete outcomes (support status, gate outcome, withheld, refused, a row's presence or absence) compare exactly
